verdicts.reason: A puts the 'Find a Store' CTA at the very top-left, jammed against the canvas edge and running into the green circle. That reverses the reading order, and the SOLSTICE wordmark sits awkwardly under the headline. B keeps the CTA at the bottom where it belongs, but the button is tiny and close to the peach circle. Its headline, wordmark and body copy are crammed into a tight stack between large empty gaps above and below.

A has the same flaws as before: the CTA is at the top-left, hard against the edge and overlapping the green circle, so the eye ends on body copy with no action. B has a sensible top-to-bottom flow (product, headline, brand, copy, full-width CTA) with even spacing. However, the can is shrunk and pushed up against the top edge over the green circle, the wordmark sits below the headline, and the bottom fifth is mostly dead space.
